ruleLine: a pool pays only on a card of the turn-up's suit / pochen compares same-rank sets (four beats three beats a pair) -- there is no declaration
board: Board (unclaimed pools carry over to the next deal)
selectFollow: Pick the next higher card of the same suit
selectFreeLead: The run is stopped -- you may lead any card
landscapeBanner: Turn your device sideways for a better view
hint.bet: you hold a set worth backing
hint.fold: you have no set and it costs to stay
hint.play: the lowest card you can legally play
tutorial.paySuit: The turn-up's suit is the pay suit. A pool goes only to whoever holds that card IN that suit -- matching the rank alone pays nothing.
tutorial.carryOver: Chips on a pool nobody claims stay put and carry into the next deal. Everyone antes again, so Marriage and Sequence build up.
tutorial.pochen: Pochen is neither a declaration nor a bluff. It compares the same-rank sets in hand: four beats three beats a pair, and rank decides ties.
tutorial.stops: In the play, each card must be the next higher of the same suit. When nobody holds it the run stops, and whoever played the last, highest card leads again with anything.
